description: QESPM synthetic benchmark: reference surfaces, simulated ion-signal maps and reference reconstructions for the linear instrument transfer function H_x(k;h) = -C k^2 exp(-|k| h), C = 1.92e3 m/s.

surfaces.z_plateau: Gaussian plateau, sigma = 30 um, A = 200 nm (resolvable)
surfaces.z_rough: power-law roughness, lc = 5 um, beta = 1.5, Ra = 100 nm
surfaces.z_fine: sinusoid, lambda = 4 um, A = 50 nm (below MTF cutoff 1.51h = 60.4 um)

reference_reconstructions.z_rec_noisy: Tikhonov, lambda = 5e5 (data with 5 Hz white-noise floor)

conventions: numpy unnormalised FFT; dw = ifft(H(kx) fft(z)).real; z = ifft(conj(H)/(|H|^2 + lambda) fft(dw)).real; phase conventions follow the centred-coordinate FFT used in the manuscript.
